input: Read /data/commits.log containing conventional commit messages (one per line, format: 'type(scope): message'). Parse each line, group by type, and generate /release/CHANGELOG.md with sections: '## Features' for 'feat' commits, '## Bug Fixes' for 'fix' commits, and '## Other' for all remaining types. Under each section list items as '- scope: message'. Print the generated changelog.

transcript.final_response:
Generated `/release/CHANGELOG.md`:

```markdown
## Features
- auth: add OAuth2 support
- ui: dark mode toggle
- api: add pagination support
- db: add connection pooling

## Bug Fixes
- api: handle null response body
- auth: token refresh race condition
- ui: button alignment on mobile
- api: correct status code for 404

## Other
- deps: update lodash to 4.17.21
- readme: update install instructions
```
tool_calls:
cat /data/commits.log && mkdir -p /release && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('/data/commits.log')
sections = {'feat': ('Features', []), 'fix': ('Bug Fixes', []), 'other': ('Other', [])}
for raw in src.read_text().splitlines():
    line = raw.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Conventional format: type(scope): message
    if ':' not in line:
        continue
    header, message = line.split(':', 1)
    message = message.strip()
    if '(' in header and header.endswith(')'):
        typ, scope = header.split('(', 1)
        scope = scope[:-1]
    else:
        typ, scope = header, ''
    bucket = typ if typ in ('feat', 'fix') else 'other'
    item = f'- {scope}: {message}' if scope else f'- {message}'
    sections[bucket][1].append(item)
content = '\n\n'.join('## ' + title + ('\n' + '\n'.join(items) if items else '') for title, items in sections.values()) + '\n'
out = Path('/release/CHANGELOG.md')
out.write_text(content)
print(content, end='')
PY
